prose: Bert Hubert's Chatcontrol 2025 brief, in its Esperanto translation (one of a dozen community translations he links and hosts). Same content as the English original: led by Denmark, many EU states want WhatsApp/Signal to scan all photos and links with AI, reporting 'doubtful' images plus location and phone number to a new EU Centre, Europol and local police - with Signal threatening to leave the EU and governments exempting their own police and military. (The page is in Esperanto; the wiki keeps content in English.)
highlights: Esperanto edition of Hubert's Chatcontrol 2025 brief
AI scans of all private photos/links, doubts reported to EU Centre, Europol, local police
Signal would rather leave the EU than implement it
Police, military and national security are exempt from the law
Hubert crowdsources translations and hosts them on his site
